title: 首長簡介
summary: 署長與副署長簡介：職稱、學歷、經歷與專長。只刊登與公務職位有關的公開資訊，首長異動時由秘書室在後台更新各人的簡介頁。
bodyMarkdown:
署長綜理署務並指揮監督所屬人員，置副署長二人襄助。本區每位首長各有一頁簡介，內容限於**職稱、學歷、證照、經歷與專長**等與公務職位有關的公開資訊，依據現行官網首長簡介整理。

署長的職掌與年度施政重點另見[署長職掌與施政重點](/about/director/)；對署長的意見請使用[署長信箱](/contact/)。

en.title: Leadership
en.summary: Profiles of the Director-General and Deputy Directors-General: title, education, career and expertise. Only public information tied to the office is published.
en.bodyMarkdown:
The Director-General oversees all affairs of the agency, assisted by two Deputy Directors-General. Each leader has a profile page limited to **title, education, licences, career and expertise**, compiled from the official profile pages on cdc.gov.tw.

See also the [Director-General's role and policy priorities](/about/director/) and the [Director-General's mailbox](/contact/).
